dedupe_keys.name: behavior and design of short reinforced ultra high performance concrete columns

description: Behavior and Design of Short Reinforced Ultra-High Performance Concrete Columns is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Matthew Bandelt, New Jersey Institute of Technology (njit.edu). This project investigates and extends an existing strength design framework for ultra-high performance concrete (UHPC) columns subject to axial-flexural and pure axial loading. Comparisons between different strength reduction interpolation schemes are evaluated to determine uniformity of safety levels in components. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 5 top-level files (TXT). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-dpwx-8y04. Keywords: Ultra-High Performance Concrete, Columns, Database, Analysis. Published 2024-11-09. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
